issue.title: Keep leaf projects moving — offer a sub-project's ready tasks when its last planned task closes
issue.description: When any managed Done gesture, on any surface, closes the task behind a leaf project's last live Task Link in today's Pomodoros, Bob offers that project's ready tasks in one picker. The picker says plainly why it appeared and that the rows are not dependents. Rust and the JS cycler apply one rule, pinned by shared vectors. Obsidian, `bob capture`, and Bob Mac Capture present it with one copy and visual system.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (from the bob-cli-fc land tale): flake in src/native/task_complete/tests/keep_moving_tests.rs::routing_is_lazy_and_narrow_with_shared_destination (added by bob-cli-fb.2.1 in 39866275). It resets the process-global statics ROUTING_LOAD_COUNT and FULL_ROOT_SCAN_COUNT (keep_moving_tests.rs:1257-1258) and later asserts FULL_ROOT_SCAN_COUNT == 0 (line 1366: left 1, right 0). FULL_ROOT_SCAN_COUNT is bumped by every full scan_root_areas in src/native/pomodoro_themes/scan.rs:180 under cfg(test), so any other unit test running in the same cargo test process that does a full-root scan between the reset and the assertion fails it. Evidence it is a flake and not a regression: on one tree, cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast passed all 4383 lib tests; the very next full run of the same code failed only this test (4382 pass, 1 fail, 1 ignored); and cargo test --lib routing_is_lazy_and_narrow_with_shared_destination alone passed 5 of 5. None of the fc changes touch task_complete, pomodoro_themes, or these counters. Fix direction: make the counters per-vault or per-thread (thread_local or keyed by the temp vault path) instead of process-global, or serialize the tests that read them behind one shared mutex.

It resets the process-global statics ROUTING_LOAD_COUNT and FULL_ROOT_SCAN_COUNT (keep_moving_tests.rs:1257-1258) and later asserts FULL_ROOT_SCAN_COUNT == 0 (line 1366: left 1, right 0). FULL_ROOT_SCAN_COUNT is bumped by every full scan_root_areas in src/native/pomodoro_themes/scan.rs:180 under cfg(test), so any other unit test running in the same cargo test process that does a full-root scan between the reset and the assertion fails it. Evidence it is a flake on an unchanged tree: pristine ccd1ada1 (git stash -u, nothing from the fc tale applied) failed cargo test --lib in 4 of 6 consecutive runs, each time with only this test failing (4375 pass, 1 fail, 1 ignored) and passed the other 2 (4376 pass); cargo test --lib routing_is_lazy_and_narrow_with_shared_destination alone passed 5 of 5. It also flipped between two identical full-workspace runs on the fc tree. None of the fc changes touch task_complete, pomodoro_themes, or these counters. Because the rate is high it will intermittently fail just check for every landing agent, even after the fmt and clippy drift is fixed. Fix direction: make the counters per-vault or per-thread (thread_local or keyed by the temp vault path) instead of process-global, or serialize the tests that read them behind one shared mutex.
